title: 怡然书屋 Yiran Shuwu
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 接秀山房、福海
evidence.excerpt_zh: 接秀山房在福海東隅正宇三楹西嚮後稍東為琴趣軒其北方樓為尋雲東南為澄練樓樓後為怡然書屋尋雲樓稍東佛室為安隠幢接秀山房之南為攬翠亭（圓明園册）臣等謹按接秀山房四十景之一與攬翠亭額皆世宗御書琴趣軒尋雲諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: East of 福海: 接秀山房, three bays facing west, with 琴趣軒, the square tower 尋雲, 澄練樓, 怡然書屋, the Buddha room 安隠幢 and 攬翠亭.

evidence.title: 怡然书屋
evidence.locator: v3 p.4, under 接秀山房; source ref 8-792
evidence.excerpt_zh: 好春倏度箭催弦，候入清和宜雨天。问我迩来心所托，即时膏澍始怡然。
evidence.summary: Poem 怡然书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

evidence.title: 怡然书屋偶题
evidence.locator: v3 p.2, under 接秀山房; source ref 8-673
evidence.excerpt_zh: 架是琳琅笥，床非玳瑁筵。识名探义府，玩象汲神渊。少暇惭茧纸，多愁忆麦田。甘膏渥盈尺，今日始怡然。
evidence.summary: Poem 怡然书屋偶题 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1763, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
